captions.detailed: A compact zoom camera lens with a telescoping barrel design. The main body is composed of a black cylindrical outer housing featuring a ribbed zoom ring and a metallic silver lens mount at the base. An inner barrel, topped with a dark glass front element, telescopes prismatically out of the main body and rotates relative to the outer barrel.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact zoom lens with a telescoping inner barrel. The outer barrel should feature a ribbed zoom ring and a silver-colored mount at its base. The inner barrel should be designed to rotate and slide prismatically along the central optical axis relative to the outer housing.
captions.factory: Construct an outer barrel part using nested cylinders, subtracting an inner bore and adding a ribbed grip ring. Create a base mount part using a thin silver cylinder. Model the inner telescoping barrel as a separate cylinder with a recessed glass-colored disk representing the lens element. Define a prismatic joint along the Z-axis to allow the inner barrel to telescope inside the outer housing, and a revolute joint on the zoom ring.
